original.target_description: Original Study 7: money allocations to stereotypical versus counterstereotypical Niffite/Luupite targets; separate conditional effects for conservatives and liberals. notes: Identity independently checked: title, Chadly Stern/Tessa V West/Nicholas O Rule, PNAS 112(50):15337–15342 (2015), and DOI 10.1073/pnas.1517662112 agree with the neutral original reference. Supplied canonical text is a PMC full-article parse (PMC4687596), containing results, Materials and Methods for Studies 1–7, and references; it is the original primary report, not a replication, preregistration, or abstract-only excerpt. No PDF was supplied. Only es_value_o is assigned; all other fields/sides are placeholders. Study 7 has distinct printed candidates: conservatives B = 0.52, SE = 0.14, Z = 3.65, P < 0.001; liberals B = −0.05, SE = 0.10, Z = −0.50, P = 0.62. These are conditional target-stereotypicality effects in money allocations, not interchangeable estimates of an overall conservative-versus-liberal difference. A Study 7 ideology-by-stereotypicality interaction coefficient is not supplied in the inspected main Study 7 results paragraph or Study 7 methods. The broad description references evaluation and certainty rather than uniquely selecting either allocation simple effect. No candidate selected, no metric conversion, no N derivation. Candidate statistics remain in notes/evidence with target_match null and confidence false pending a more precise test locator.
